description:
*ROTARY CLUB OF - SKYCITY, BORIVALI*
*Journey: ANAND SE PARMANAND TAK*
*30th Oct - 1st Nov 2026 | Anand, Gujarat*

*Every word and every situation is carried forward - that's the beauty of this journey.*

It was not just a tour from Skycity to Anand, it was a journey crafted with heart - *Spiritual, Educational and Emotional.*

*1. SPIRITUAL JOURNEY - Anand Se Parmanand*
Our soul found its peace.
We took divine darshan at *Dakor - Ranchhodraiji Temple*, felt the divine light at *Manilaxmi Tirth - The Golden Temple*, and were blessed at *Vadtal - Laxminarayan Mandir*. Three dhams, one emotion - Parmanand.

*2. EDUCATIONAL JOURNEY - Learning from the Roots*
We saw how India grows. We witnessed the live process of *Milk and Chocolate production*, understood the cooperative spirit of Anand. The insightful *meeting with the Vice Chancellor* gave us vision and knowledge beyond books.

*3. ROTARY JOURNEY - Fellowship Beyond Boundaries*
The true spirit of Rotary shone bright. We had a warm *flag exchange and fellowship meeting with the Rotary Clubs of District 3020*. Different districts, same heartbeat - Service Above Self. A bond of Skycity and 3020 was created forever.

*4. LAUGHTER JOURNEY - The Tonda, Gotya & Lion Safari*
What is a Skycity tour without full-on laughter?
Our very own *Tonda, Gotya and the Lion Safari* moments kept the entire bus roaring with laughter. Jokes, mimicry, and non-stop masti - our stomachs pained from laughing!

And then the highlight - *Few had carried the OSC to Anand and also in the bus... and the Judge was not able to decide!* The competition was so tough and so hilarious that even the judge surrendered. OSC - Our Sweet Confusion kept us all entertained.

*5. THE GRAND FINALE - Rush to Catch the Train*
And how can we forget the last-minute thrill? The *final rush to catch Train No. 20902* at the last minute. Running, panting, counting members, pulling luggage - full filmy climax! That rush will be remembered for years.

*Conclusion:*
This tour proved - *True relations are not found, they are crafted by proper crafting.* From spiritual darshan to chocolate factory, from flag exchange to last-minute train rush, every moment was woven with love, affection and strong bonding.

We left as members, we returned as family.

*Anand se Parmanand tak ki ye yatra, hamesha yaad rahegi.*

Thank you to all organizers and every participants.
